name: survey-showdown
description: Survey Showdown: a self-hosted, real-time survey-answer party game (host console, projector board, phone buzzers).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @survey-showdown/web && npm run build -w @survey-showdown/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/web && tsc -p e2e
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
